    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  rw [funext_iff]
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := not_forall.1 h
  have hpos : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by positivity
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) x₀ :=
    (Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨δ, δpos, hδ⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont (⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ) hpos
  haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
  let φ1 : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 4, δ / 2, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  let φ := φ1.toFun
  have hφ_test : IsTestFunction φ := ⟨φ1.contDiff, φ1.hasCompactSupport⟩
  let g : Y → V := fun x => φ x • f x₀
  have hg_test : IsTestFunction g := IsTestFunction.smul_right hφ_test contDiff_const
  have hkey : ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0 := by
    simp [g, inner_smul_right']
    exact hg g hg_test
  have hnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.support φ
    · exact mul_nonneg (φ1.nonneg x hx)
        (by
          rw [ContDiffBump.support_eq] at hx
          have h : |⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ - ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ| < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by simpa using hδ hx
          rw [abs_lt] at h
          linarith)
    · simp [Function.notMem_support.mp hx]
  have hμ : 0 < μ (Metric.ball x₀ (δ/4)) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos μ (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr δpos)
  have hsupp : Metric.ball x₀ (δ/4) ⊆ Function.support (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    have hφx : 0 < φ x := φ1.pos_of_mem_ball hx
    have hin : 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
      have h : |⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ - ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ| < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
        simpa using hδ hx
      rw [abs_lt] at h
      linarith
    simp only [Function.support_mul, Set.mem_inter_iff, Function.mem_support]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hint : Integrable (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) μ :=
    φ1.contDiff.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (φ1.supp.mono (by simp [Function.support_mul, Set.mem_inter_iff, Function.mem_support]))
  have hpos_int : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ :=
    (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg hnonneg hint).mpr
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hμ (measure_mono hsupp))
